mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_line (order_id, item_id, qty, unit_price, amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty), 0) FROM order_line ol JOIN customer_order co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id WHERE ol.item_id = #{itemId} AND co.status != 'CANCELLED'
SELECT ol.* FROM order_line ol JOIN customer_order co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id WHERE ol.item_id = #{itemId} AND co.status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY co.order_date ASC, ol.line_id ASC
